$description: DENSITY overrides — compact. Merged over base + theme + component and emitted as a [data-density="compact"] block in tokens.css, so it may only re-value tokens that already exist, and only with theme-independent values (dimensions/numbers — the build rejects anything that resolves differently per theme). The targets are the component-tier knobs, NOT the primitive space scale: re-valuing space.4 under compact would tighten hero rhythm and marketing pages along with the tables, and make every `space.4 = 16px` description a lie. Comfortable is the plain document — no file, no attribute.

md.$description: 32px loses the 44px touch target even counting the focus ring — compact is for pointer-first data UIs, never touch
